nphi.summary: 2011 IANPHI grants funded research by NIMR (perinatal care) and UVRI (Aedes vector ecology; research-to-policy communication) and HIV/STD research training of INSP Côte d'Ivoire faculty at the University of Washington.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development

nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: Gates-funded NPHI development grant for Guinea-Bissau's INASA
nphi.with: INASA Guinea-Bissau; Fiocruz; Instituto de Higiene e Medicina Tropical (IHMT); Nigerian Institute of Medical Research (NIMR)
nphi.summary: IANPHI gave INASA a three-year NPHI development grant and was the first donor for its headquarters, opened in February 2011. Fiocruz and IHMT advised on rebuilding the lab and on disease monitoring, and NIMR's director mentored INASA's…

nphi.title: NIMR technical assistance to UVRI on financial management
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI)
nphi.summary: Within IANPHI's comprehensive projects, NIMR helped UVRI set up a financial management system and a research support office. About US$16M was leveraged afterwards.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Nigeria – Phase 2
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare; Federal Ministries of Environment and Agriculture; Mott MacDonald (Fleming Fund Management Agent); WHO; FAO
nphi.summary: MSH leads the UK-funded Fleming Fund phase 2 country grant in Nigeria, working with NCDC and sector ministries to improve One Health AMR surveillance data, analysis and use.

nphi.title: JICA Project for Strengthening Detection of and Response to Public Health Threats in Nigeria
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), National Reference Laboratory Abuja
nphi.summary: JICA technical cooperation with NCDC to strengthen detection of and response to public health threats, including support to the National Reference Laboratory during COVID-19.
